# Claude Code Settings Check

> Paste a Claude Code settings.json to find hooks that never fire and permission rules that never match: bad matchers, typos, duplicates. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
